# GAViewer (multi-purpose program for geometric algebra computations and visualization)
#

message(DEBUG "Entering the GAViewer2 subdirectory ...")

set(GAVR_SOURCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")

##########################################################################
#
#   GAViewer executable target to build
#

set(algebras "gaviewer_algebras")
set(core "gaviewer_core")
set(target "GAViewer2")

# The geometric algebras (generated by Gaigen 1): one static library per
# algebra (gaviewer_e3ga, ...), without any dependency on the rest of
# GAViewer, and an interface library that bundles them. An algebra is
# included as "<name>/<name>.h" (or all of them as "gaincludes.h").
add_library(gaviewer_e3ga STATIC
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/e3ga/e3ga.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/e3ga/e3ga_optc.cpp"
)
add_library(gaviewer_p3ga STATIC
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/p3ga/p3ga.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/p3ga/p3ga_optc.cpp"
)
add_library(gaviewer_c3ga STATIC
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/c3ga/c3ga.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/c3ga/c3ga_optc.cpp"
)
add_library(gaviewer_c5ga STATIC
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/c5ga/c5ga.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/c5ga/c5ga_optc.cpp"
)
add_library(gaviewer_i2ga STATIC
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/i2ga/i2ga.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/i2ga/i2ga_optc2.cpp"
)
# (gaviewer_e3ga, the Gaigen e3ga, is only used by the differential test gadiff.e3ga:
# GAViewer uses the Garamon e3ga, see gaviewer_ga below)
target_include_directories(gaviewer_e3ga PUBLIC "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}")
set(algebra_targets gaviewer_p3ga gaviewer_c3ga gaviewer_c5ga gaviewer_i2ga)
foreach(lib ${algebra_targets})
  target_include_directories(${lib} PUBLIC "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}")
endforeach()

add_library(${algebras} INTERFACE)
target_link_libraries(${algebras} INTERFACE ${algebra_targets})

# The Garamon based algebra layer (src/ga, header-only): the Garamon generated
# algebras (garamon_<name>, see garamon/CMakeLists.txt) plus the operations
# GAViewer needs and Garamon does not provide.
set(ga "gaviewer_ga")
add_library(${ga} INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(${ga} INTERFACE "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(${ga} INTERFACE garamon_e3ga garamon_p3ga)

# Everything else except the entry point goes into a static library, so that
# the GUI application and the headless regression harness (viewer/test) are
# built from exactly the same object code:
add_library(${core} STATIC
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/c3gaobject.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/c5gaobject.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/conformalobject.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/console/console.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/console/consolealgebrafunctions.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/console/consoleautocolor.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/console/consolecontrol.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/console/consoledynstmt.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/console/consolefunctions.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/console/consolegafile.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/console/consolegeneralfunctions.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/console/consolelangparser.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/console/consoleoperators.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/console/consolescope.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/console/consolesourcefileread.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/console/consolestatement.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/console/consoletest.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/console/consolevariable.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/console/consolewindow.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/console/fl_console.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/draw.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/dynamicstatementwindow.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/e3gaobject.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/gafile.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/geosphere.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/glwindow.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/i2gaobject.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/mainwindow.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/meshobject.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/mt19937-2.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/mvint.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/mvintc3ga.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/mvintc5ga.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/mvinte3ga.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/mvinti2ga.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/mvintp3ga.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/netclient.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/netserver.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/object.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/osdep.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/p3gaobject.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/pngwrapper.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/polygonobject.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/screenshot.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/screenshotdialog.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/selectwindow.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/softpic.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/state.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/textobject.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/tubedraw.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/typeset/fontdata.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/typeset/fontlex.c"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/typeset/fontparse.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/typeset/fontyacc.c"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/typeset/openglfont.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/typeset/typeset.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/typeset/typesetbox.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/ui.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/util.cpp"
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/writestate.cpp"
)
target_include_directories(${core} PUBLIC "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}")

# The GUI application: the entry point plus the core library.
add_executable(${target}
  "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/main.cpp"
)

# Add resources (icon)
if (CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME MATCHES "Windows")
  target_sources(${target} PRIVATE "${GAVR_SOURCE_DIR}/gaviewer.rc")
endif()

##########################################################################
#
#   COMPILE DEFINITIONS & OPTIONS
#

if (CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME MATCHES "Windows")
  
  target_compile_definitions(${core}
    PUBLIC WIN32              # application being built for Windows
    PUBLIC _MBCS              # for Multibyte Character Set
  )
  target_compile_definitions(${target}
    PRIVATE WIN32_NO_CONSOLE  # without a console (WinMain entry point in main.cpp)
  )

  set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES
    WIN32_EXECUTABLE ON       # the executable must have a WinMain entry point
  )

endif()

# When compiling GAViewer source code (which is years old), many
# deprecation warnings appear. It's worth turning them off to
# get a clearer picture of the compilation and spot more serious
# issues (if any).

foreach(tgt gaviewer_e3ga ${algebra_targets} ${core} ${target})

  if (CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT MATCHES "MSVC")

    target_compile_definitions(${tgt} PRIVATE
      # deprecation warnings for the older, less secure functions
      _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS   
    )
    target_compile_options(${tgt} PRIVATE
      -W3       # production quality warnings
      -wd4996   # deprecated function, class member, variable, or typedef
    )

  elseif (CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT MATCHES "GNU")

    target_compile_options(${tgt}
      PRIVATE
      -Wall
      -Wno-deprecated
      -Wno-parentheses
      -Wno-unused-variable
    )
    if (CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
      target_compile_options(${tgt}
        PRIVATE
        # function declaration without a prototype is deprecated in all versions of C
        -Wno-deprecated-non-prototype
        -Wno-format-security
      )
    endif()

  endif()

  ##########################################################################
  #
  #   ADDRESS SANITIZER
  #
  #   NOTE: I have not been able to get Address Sanitizer to work on Windows
  #        (regardless of the compiler used)!
  #

  if(USE_ASAN)
    # if (CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT MATCHES "MSVC")
    #   # _DISABLE_*_ANNOTATION definitions are (were?) required to avoid error:
    #   #
    #   #    lld-link: error: /INFERASANLIBS is not allowed in .drectve
    #   #
    #   target_compile_definitions(${tgt} PRIVATE
    #     _DISABLE_STRING_ANNOTATION
    #     _DISABLE_VECTOR_ANNOTATION
    #   )
    # endif()
    # Note: MSVC accepts both slash (/) and dash (-) options
    target_compile_options(${tgt} PRIVATE -fsanitize=address)
    # target_link_options(${tgt} PRIVATE -fsanitize=address)
  endif()

endforeach()

##########################################################################
#
#   LINK OPTIONS & LIBRARIES
#

target_link_libraries(${core}
  PUBLIC ${algebras}
  PUBLIC ${ga}
  PUBLIC fltk::png
  PUBLIC fltk::gl
  PUBLIC fltk::fltk
)
target_link_libraries(${target}
  PRIVATE ${core}
)

# Take advantage of interprocedural optimization (IPO/LTO), if available:
include(CheckIPOSupported OPTIONAL RESULT_VARIABLE check_ipo_module_found)
if(check_ipo_module_found)
  check_ipo_supported(
    RESULT LTO_OPTIMIZATION_SUPPORTED
    OUTPUT LTO_OPTIMIZATION_ERROR
    LANGUAGES C CXX
  )
  if(LTO_OPTIMIZATION_SUPPORTED)
    set_property(TARGET ${algebra_targets} ${core} ${target} PROPERTY INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION TRUE)
  else()
    message(DEBUG "Interprocedural optimization (IPO/LTO) is not supported: ${LTO_OPTIMIZATION_ERROR}")
  endif()
endif()

# Check libraries usage:
set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES LINK_WHAT_YOU_USE ON)

##########################################################################
#
#   INSTALL
#

install(
  TARGETS ${target} 
  DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}
  COMPONENT GAViewer
)

#   After compilation, the application can be installed using a command
#   similar to the following:
#
#     cmake --install ~/GAViewer/build [--component GAViewer] --prefix /my/install/prefix
#
#   For example, on Windows, it could be:
#
#     cmake --install %USERPROFILE%\source\repos\GAViewer\build [--component GAViewer] --prefix %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\GAViewer
#
#   If you omit the '--component' parameter, CMake will install everything i.e.
#   the GAViewer executable, sample figures, but also FLTK (libraries and headers).
#
